message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, or a holiday that is observed on the nearest weekday when it lands on a weekend. The dates shown are the *actual* holiday dates; the “observed” dates are included where applicable.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if any) | Typical Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Monday, Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Tue) |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PEI, SK, etc.) | **Friday, Feb 20** | – | **Feb 18–20** (Fri–Sun) |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Friday, Apr 7** | – | **Apr 7–10** (Fri–Mon) |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Monday, May 22** | – | **May 20–22** (Fri–Mon) |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Saturday, Jul 1** | Monday, Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Monday, Sep 4** | – | **Sep 2–4** (Fri–Mon) |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Monday, Oct 9** | – | **Oct 7–9** (Fri–Mon) |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | **Saturday, Nov 11** | Monday, Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Sat–Mon) |
| 9 | Christmas | **Monday, Dec 25** | – | **Dec 23–25** (Fri–Mon) |
|10 | Boxing Day | **Tuesday, Dec 26** | – | **Dec 23–26** (Fri–Tue) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a simple array or database table.  
2. **Mark the “observed” dates** as the official holiday if you want to show the day off that employees actually get.  
3. **Highlight the long‑weekend spans** in your UI so users can see the full break at a glance.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province (some provinces have extra holidays like St. Patrick’s Day, St. John’s Day, etc.) or if you need the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
